story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: Love Joy Happiness was born in 2025 from a desire to bring color and personality to people's lives through unique, personalized creations. It all started with a printer and a simple idea: to turn our customers' visions into reality.
story.p2: From eye-catching flyers to creative stickers and elegant essential oil labels, we have grown steadily to offer complete personalization solutions. Every project is a new opportunity to bring joy and give life to our customers' ideas.
story.p3: Today, we are proud of our modern workshop equipped with state-of-the-art machinery, enabling us to deliver high-quality products. Whether it's flyers for special events, custom stickers, or labels for essential oil brands, we put passion and attention to detail into every project.

s1.heading: 1. Introduction
s1.text: Love Joy Happiness is committed to protecting the privacy of our website visitors. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.

s2.heading: 2. Information we collect
s2.intro: We collect the following types of information:
items: Contact information: name, email address, phone number
Delivery information: delivery address, delivery preferences
Order information: purchase history, product preferences
Technical information: IP address, browser type (automatically collected by the server)
Payment information: securely processed by Stripe (we do not store card details)

s3.heading: 3. How we use your information
s3.intro: We use the collected information to:
items: Process and deliver your orders
Communicate with you about orders and services
Improve your experience on our website
Send updates about new products (only with your consent)
Comply with legal and tax obligations

s4.heading: 4. Sharing your information
s4.text: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following situations: delivery services for shipping orders, payment processors for secure transactions, or when required by law.

s5.heading: 5. Data security
s5.text: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. All transactions are processed through Stripe with SSL encryption.

s6.heading: 6. Local data storage
s6.text: Our website does not use cookies. Instead, we use localStorage to temporarily store your shopping cart items on your device. This information stays only on your computer and is not sent to our servers until you place an order.

s7.heading: 7. Your rights
s7.intro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: The right to access your personal information
The right to rectification of incorrect data
The right to erasure of your data ("the right to be forgotten")
The right to restriction of processing
The right to data portability
The right to object to processing

s8.heading: 8. Data retention
s8.text: We retain your personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

s9.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
s9.text: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy at any time. Changes will be published on this page with the date of update. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policy.

s10.heading: 10. Contact
s10.text: For questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, you can reach us via:

s1.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.text: By accessing and using the Love Joy Happiness website, you agree to comply with and be bound by these terms and conditions of use. If you do not agree with any of these terms, please do not use our website.

s2.heading: 2. About our services
s2.intro: Love Joy Happiness offers online sales of:
items: Custom and standard stickers
Advertising and decorative banners
Labels for various uses
Flyers and promotional materials
Other printing and personalization products

s3.heading: 3. User accounts
s3.text: To place orders, you may need to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password, and for restricting access to your computer.

s4_1.heading: 4.1 Placing orders
s4_1.text: All orders are subject to product availability. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order for reasonable cause.

s4_2.heading: 4.2 Prices
s4_2.text: Prices displayed on the website include VAT and are in Romanian lei (RON). We reserve the right to change prices without prior notice.

s4_3.heading: 4.3 Payments
s4_3.text: We accept bank card payments, processed securely through Stripe. Payment must be made in full before the order is processed.

s5_1.heading: 5.1 Delivery times
s5_1.text: Estimated delivery times are provided at the time of order and may vary depending on product complexity and delivery destination.

s5_2.heading: 5.2 Shipping costs
s5_2.text: Shipping costs are calculated based on the size, weight, and destination of the order and will be displayed before checkout is finalized.

s5_3.heading: 5.3 Delivery responsibility
s5_3.text: The risk of loss and title for purchased items pass to the buyer at the time of delivery to the courier company.

s6_1.heading: 6.1 Custom products
s6_1.text: Custom products may only be returned in the case of manufacturing defects or errors on our part.

s6_2.heading: 6.2 Standard products
s6_2.text: Standard products may be returned within 14 days of delivery, in original and unused condition.

s6_3.heading: 6.3 Return process
s6_3.text: To initiate a return, contact us by email or via the contact page. Return shipping costs are borne by the customer, except where the product is defective.

s7.heading: 7. Intellectual property
s7.text: All website content, including text, graphics, logos, images, and software, is the property of Love Joy Happiness and is protected by copyright law. For custom products, the customer guarantees that they hold the rights to the design provided.

s8.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
s8.text: Love Joy Happiness will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use of our products. Our total liability will not exceed the value of the purchased product.

s9.heading: 9. Changes to terms
s9.text: We reserve the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication on the website. Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of the changes.

s10.heading: 10. Governing law
s10.text: These terms and conditions are governed by the laws of Romania. Any disputes will be resolved by the competent courts of Romania.
